description: College Savings Calculator with a chart, the same math as the web page. How much should you save for college? Pick a kind of school. See how much to save each month so your savings can pay the bills. It grows today’s school prices from US Department of Education data to the start year, then finds a monthly amount. It does not say what college will cost. Prices can rise faster than in the past. People ask for it as "529 calculator", "college savings calculator" or "how much should i save for college".

cost.description: Cost of one year of college. US dollars. See average prices in the (i) Default: 24286.

growth.description: Price growth each year. A percent: 5 means 5%. Default: 4.

keep.description: Keep saving during college. Default: no.

monthly.description: You save each month. US dollars. Default: 300.

rate.description: Yearly return to test. A percent: 5 means 5%. Default: 3.4.

saved.description: Saved so far. US dollars. Default: 0.

share.description: Share of the cost you will pay. A percent: 5 means 5%. Default: 100.

startAge.description: Age college starts. In years. Default: 18.

stepUp.description: Raise deposits each year. A percent: 5 means 5%. Your monthly amount grows this much yearly Default: 0.

years.description: Years in college. In years. Default: 4.

name: plan_college_savings
title: College Savings Calculator
